summary: Enhance your skills with our comprehensive Machine Learning & IoT Training Course. Learn from experts and gain hands-on experience in cutting-edge technologies.
lede: Internet of things and machine learning training covers connecting device data to practical analysis and operational decisions. It is designed for professionals working with connected devices, telemetry, or automation who need to prepare time-series sensor data, select and validate models, and plan anomaly alerts and deployments.
audienceIntro: This machine learning and IoT training is designed for professionals who need to turn device data into operational insight and practical automation.
audience: Operations Managers using telemetry for performance decisions
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of spreadsheets, basic data concepts, and comfort reading simple technical diagrams. No coding background is required, although familiarity with Python, APIs, or cloud dashboards will help you move faster. You should bring a laptop for practical exercises, and you will benefit from preparing one real or representative IoT use case from your work context.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
